parts.text: In this experiment, you will determine the focal length of a converging lens. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 3.1. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) Place the lens a distance u = 20.0 cm from the triangular illuminated object. Place the screen near the lens. Switch on the lamp. Move the screen until a clear focused image of the triangular illuminated object is seen on the screen. Measure, and record in Table 3.1, the distance v between the lens and the screen. Repeat the procedure for u = 30.0 cm, 40.0 cm, 50.0 cm and 60.0 cm. Switch off the lamp. Table 3.1 u / cm v / cm u v 20.0 30.0 40.0 50.0 60.0 [2]
